messages:
alex: noticed attach queue spike in eu-west2, ~120 pending since 06:05. iowait looks high on several gnodes.
maria: nvme metadata checksum warnings on gnode-eu-12 and gnode-eu-13 clusters. attaching retries flooding controller.
sahil: is it actual media errors or background maintenance causing saturation?
alex: quick dmesg from gnode-eu-12-03:
```
[ 900.123456] nvme0: metadata checksum mismatch, ns 1
[ 900.124000] nvme-core: retrying IO due to media error
[ 901.000111] scrubber: scheduling deep-scrub for corrupt extent
```
maria: scrubber and tempfile janitor both ran at full concurrency after last night's rollout. combined they pushed IOPS to ~98%.
sahil: short-term: throttle scrub concurrency and suspend janitor for eu-west2. also prefer healthy zones for new attaches for 15m.
maria: doing it now. commands:
```
kubectl -n storage set env daemonset/scrubber SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=1 --context=prod-eu-west2
kubectl -n janitor patch cronjob/tempfile-sweep -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}' --context=prod-eu-west2
```
ops-bot: scrubber concurrency reduced; tempfile-sweep suspended in eu-west2.
infra-oncall: alert throttled for 10m while mitigation runs.
alex: pending attaches down 120 -> 35 after throttles. iowait trending down.
sahil: next: run non-destructive deep-verify on affected drives, file vendor support ticket for firmware cohort, and add guard to avoid concurrent deep-scrub + janitor in same AZ.
maria: filing runbook and small RB to gate scrub by iowait metric. tagging infra-oncall.
alex: if corrupt extents rise we'll retire affected hosts and reprovision. monitoring closely.
sahil: nice work, keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
